name: xlsx-viewer
title: XLSX Viewer
description: A fixed-window virtualized Excel/spreadsheet viewer rendered entirely client-side: sheet tabs, zoom, download, formatted values, numeric alignment, sparse workbook storage, and row + column virtualization so huge sheets stay smooth. No useEffect for data loading.

import type * as React from "react"

export function getFixedGridRowStyle({
  gridTemplate,
  rowHeight,
  top,
  contain = true,
}: {
  gridTemplate?: string
  rowHeight: number
  top: number
  contain?: boolean
}): React.CSSProperties {
  const safeRowHeight = Number.isFinite(rowHeight) && rowHeight > 0 ? rowHeight : 0
  const safeTop = Number.isFinite(top) && top > 0 ? top : 0
  const style: React.CSSProperties = {
    height: safeRowHeight,
    minHeight: safeRowHeight,
    position: "absolute",
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    width: "100%",
    transform: `translate3d(0, ${safeTop}px, 0)`,
  }
  if (gridTemplate?.trim()) style.gridTemplateColumns = gridTemplate
  if (contain) style.contain = "layout paint style"
  return style
}

export const XLSX_BASE_ROW_HEIGHT = 28
export const XLSX_BASE_COLUMN_WIDTH = 128
export const XLSX_BASE_GUTTER_WIDTH = 52
export const XLSX_BASE_FONT_SIZE = 13
